scope: The CONFIGURE_TOTP page: what its QR code holds and how it is drawn, the issuer from the display name with ${key} resolved in the user locale, the manual-entry mode and the links between the modes, and the mode a failed code re-shows.
normalization: The base URL and realm names are replaced with placeholders; the QR code is read by tests/qr_code.py into its pixel size, module size, quiet zone, version, error correction level, segment modes and text, with the base32 secret as {secret}; pages are reduced by tests/page_texts.py without the language choice; the shown key is reduced to whether it is the base32 secret in groups of four.
